# moarch

**Tag**: cli, scaffolding, clean-architecture, riverpod, bloc, mobile, state-management, tooling

## 简介

Flutter CLI — scaffold Clean Architecture projects with Riverpod or flutter_bloc, FVM and your own conventions.
